BRACE|TILDE|MARK ?/ = 3 0 |
BRACE|TILDE|MARK [.]* = 3 0 |
BRACE|TILDE|MARK **/ = 0 1 dir1/ dir2/ empty/ noperm/ |
BRACE|TILDE|MARK ?*/ = 0 1 dir1/ dir2/ empty/ noperm/ |
BRACE|TILDE|MARK [!x]/ = 3 0 |
BRACE|TILDE|MARK ??/ = 3 0 |
pattern_p 0 \x = 0
pattern_p 1 \x = 0
pattern_p 0 a = 0
pattern_p 1 a = 0
pattern_p 0 * = 1
pattern_p 1 * = 1
pattern_p 0 ? = 1
pattern_p 1 ? = 1
pattern_p 0 a*b = 1
pattern_p 1 a*b = 1
pattern_p 0 [ = 0
pattern_p 1 [ = 0

pattern_p 1 [a = 0

pattern_p 1 [a] = 1
pattern_p 0 a] = 0
pattern_p 1 a] = 0
pattern_p 0 ] = 0
pattern_p 1 ] = 0
pattern_p 0 [] = 1
pattern_p 1 [] = 1
pattern_p 0 []] = 1
pattern_p 1 []] = 1
pattern_p 0 \x5c* = 1
pattern_p 1 \x5c* = 0
pattern_p 0 \x5c? = 1
pattern_p 1 \x5c? = 0
pattern_p 0 \x5c[a] = 1
pattern_p 1 \x5c[a] = 0

pattern_p 1 [\x5c]] = 1

pattern_p 1 a\x5c = 0
pattern_p 0 \x5c = 0
pattern_p 1 \x5c = 0

pattern_p 1 {a,b} = 0

pattern_p 1 ~ = 0
pattern_p 0 a[b\x5c]c = 1
pattern_p 1 a[b\x5c]c = 0
pattern_p 0 [!a] = 1
pattern_p 1 [!a] = 1

pattern_p 1 ** = 1
